{"path":"neuron_growth_openrouter-moonshotai-kimi-k3_01.html","edit_description":"Create a NEW single self-contained HTML file implementing an animated neon "neuron growth" canvas simulation. Vanilla JavaScript + dat.gui only (dat.gui via CDN script tag: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js). No other external libraries, frameworks, modules, images, or assets. Do not mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style anywhere in code or comments.

LAYOUT / CSS:
- Dark page background #05070f. One 800x800 <canvas> centered horizontally and vertically (flexbox centering, margin auto). Canvas has a subtle outer glow via CSS box-shadow using #101a3a, and a thin 1px border rgba(0,229,255,0.25).
- Slightly gritty futuristic look: high contrast, glowing.

EXACT NEON PALETTE (use these as defaults):
- Background: #05070f
- Background glow: #101a3a
- Main branch color: #00e5ff
- Secondary branch accent: #d6ff00
- Synapse color: #ff2bd6
- Pulse color: #fff36a
- UI/accent color: #ffd400
- Optional scanline/grid color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)

SIMULATION (keep code simple, compact, lightweight arrays/objects only):
- Setup: on start (and on "regenerate network"), spawn N seed neurons (default random 3-6, controlled by "neuron count" slider) at random positions near the canvas center (within ~120px radius of center). Each neuron is {x, y, branches: []}.
- Neuron growth: each neuron recursively grows branching axon/dendrite lines. Growth is ANIMATED step-by-step (a few segments per frame based on "branch growth speed"), not instant. Each branch is a polyline of points grown segment by segment; each new segment deviates direction by a small random angle scaled by "branch curvature"; render each branch as a smooth path using quadratic curves (quadraticCurveTo through midpoints) for organic shapes. Branch thickness varies slightly randomly (e.g. 0.6–2.2 px, tapering with depth). Occasionally spawn smaller side branches while growing, with probability "branch split chance", up to "max branch depth" recursion limit and a hard total branch cap (e.g. 900) for performance. Segment length limited by "max branch length". Stop growing once network reaches stable size (all branches finished or cap hit).
- Synapse detection: periodically (and after growth ends) check branch TIPS of different neurons; when two tips come within "synapse distance threshold" pixels, create a synapse {a, b, x, y, phase}. Prevent duplicate synapses between the same branch pair (store a Set of "branchA|branchB" keys). Cap synapse count (e.g. 250).
- Pulse animation: pulses travel between connected neurons/synapses. Each pulse {from, to, t} moves smoothly by linear interpolation along the straight line (or along branch polyline) at "pulse speed"; spawn new random pulses over time at a rate controlled by "pulse frequency" (probability per frame), on random existing synapses or along random branches. Keep the scene alive after growth ends: continuously spawn pulses on random paths. Cap active pulses (e.g. 120).

RENDERING (requestAnimationFrame loop, keep it lightweight, no particle systems, no physics/pathfinding):
- Each frame: fill canvas with background color (slight alpha fade NOT required — full clear is fine), draw faint background radial glow (#101a3a radial gradient centered), optional faint scanlines (horizontal lines every 4px using rgba(0,229,255,0.08)) and/or subtle animated noise dots — canvas only, cheap.
- Draw branches as thin glowing neon lines: strokeStyle branch color (#00e5ff), some branches (e.g. every 5th or depth>2) use accent color (#d6ff00); use ctx.shadowBlur (e.g. 8-14) with shadowColor matching stroke for bloom. shadowBlur ONLY for bloom (no images).
- Neuron somas: small glowing circles at seed positions (UI/accent #ffd400 or branch color), shadowBlur glow.
- Synapses: glowing dots brighter than branches, radius and alpha pulsing over time via sin(time + phase), glow strength scaled by "synapse glow strength", color #ff2bd6, larger shadowBlur.
- Pulses: moving electric sparks — small bright dot (#fff36a) with short trailing line segment, brightness scaled by "pulse brightness", strong shadowBlur.
- Vignette: after drawing, overlay a radial gradient (transparent center -> rgba(0,0,0,0.55) edges) for a faint vignette around canvas edges.
- Pause/resume flag: when paused, skip simulation+render updates but keep the rAF loop alive.

GUI (dat.gui):
- Panel with folders exactly named: "Growth", "Synapses", "Pulses", "Visuals".
- Growth folder: neuron count (1–12, step 1), branch growth speed (0.5–10), max branch depth (1–10, step 1), branch split chance (0–0.5), branch curvature (0–1), max branch length (5–60).
- Synapses folder: synapse distance threshold (5–80), synapse glow strength (0–3).
- Pulses folder: pulse speed (0.5–10), pulse frequency (0–0.2), pulse brightness (0–3).
- Visuals folder: color pickers for background color, branch color, accent branch color, synapse color, pulse color (defaults from palette above).
- Top-level buttons (gui.add on a control object): "regenerate network" (rebuilds everything), "clear canvas" (clears drawing, keeps sim state), "pause/resume animation" (toggles paused flag). Changing structural Growth params (neuron count, depth, split chance, curvature, max length) may call regenerate on onFinishChange.

CODE STRUCTURE: single <script> at end of body, organized with short comments marking sections: // --- Setup ---, // --- GUI setup ---, // --- Neuron growth ---, // --- Synapse detection ---, // --- Pulse animation ---, // --- Rendering ---. Short comments explaining major sections. Keep everything compact and readable."}
